abstract: Ports the next-starters playwright-testid-catalog skill to Angular. Builds a single typed data-testid catalog per feature area instead of scattering string literals across Angular components and Playwright specs. A shared createTestIdRegistry helper builds a nested, as-const catalog object keyed by view/section (list/detail/create/edit/dialogs) with a documented element-suffix vocabulary, and validates id uniqueness at dev-time by throwing on duplicate leaf values. A Playwright-side mirror module re-exports the identical catalog object so app and test code can never drift apart on an id string, and dynamic per-row ids follow a prefix-${id} convention with an optional reverse-parse fallback. The registry/mirror mechanics are pure TypeScript with no framework dependency, so they are carried over unchanged from the React/Next.js original; only the component-binding illustration is adapted to Angular's [attr.data-testid] template-binding syntax. Encodes 7 invariants plus reference templates for the registry helper, an example feature catalog, and its Playwright mirror.
